name: Astrid Olsen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After earning a degree in theoretical physics, she found herself drawn to the complex calculations and strategic challenges of racing. She started as a data analyst for a smaller rally team, quickly proving her ability to predict outcomes and optimize performance under pressure.

Her tactical acumen led to a role as a strategist for a Formula 3 team, before being headhunted by JOTA Sport. Astrid is known for her meticulous planning and her ability to remain calm and focused even in the most chaotic race conditions. Her strengths lie in long-term planning and leveraging every possible advantage to maximize race results, making her a key asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Astrid has a serious, focused look with a kind smile when she allows herself to relax.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of 'The Art of War'
Has a specific lucky pen she uses for every race strategy document
Prefers working in near silence, even during high-pressure moments
